headline: Marban Hollow Surges as Strand and Mercy See Action
war_summary: Since the last edition Marban Hollow has flared to seven changes in two hours, nine in six, seventeen on the day about Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall for three Warden, four Colonial and one destroyed holdings, last logged at 1351, while Kuura Strand runs to the hour with four changes in two hours, twelve on the day about Talven and Faden Point for five Colonial and one destroyed, latest at 1501. Linn Mercy remains lively with three changes in two hours, sixteen on the day about Outwich Ranch, Lathair and Hardline for two Warden, eight Colonial and one destroyed, last at 1421, and the Weathered Expanse counts two in two hours, forty-eight on the day about Crow's Nest, Spirit Watch and Wightwalk for five Warden, one Colonial and three destroyed, also at 1421. Mooring County shows two fresh changes at 1451 about the Wind Hills under twelve Warden holdings, Stlican Shelf two at 1321 about Briar under nine Colonial, while Nevish Line, despite fifty-four on the day, has logged nothing in six hours since 0504. Callahan's Passage reports 5,115 Colonial and 3,560 Warden casualties on the day with accelerating rates but no recorded transfer.
